subject: S23-E started: batch 1 (system 05 nervous system + eye + ear) in authoring
body: Plan: batch 1 = system 05 (33 leaf areas incl. 05.17 eye, 05.18 ear), then batch 2 = system 04 (11 areas). Per area: Step 1 + Step 2 CK sections, >=7 items per Step, cards, original SVG figures (lesion localisation: facial pathway, vascular territories, cord cross-section, visual pathway, audiogram). Pipeline verified on a pilot: validator ok, local stack import ok (all verify checks green, figures in local Storage). Will integrate batch 1 when merged + reviewed; counts follow in the next update.
